name: The Hollow Belly
summary: Vampiric Touch a few times a day, and resistance to necrotic damage. The price: 1 fewer Hit Point per level, and you can't spend Hit Dice on a day you haven't fed.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: Your hand can drink. Life runs up your arm like warm wine, and whatever is killing you finds less to work with.

cost.flaw: You are always hungry, and bread doesn't help.
cost.text: The emptiness in you is real. You cannot spend Hit Dice to heal during a Short Rest on a day when you haven't drained a living creature.

implemented: partial: the Hit Dice restriction is text only (no rest conditions yet).
